title: refactor(Development/WeilBound): derive oneVecBinaryMass from LocalMassFormula and remove OneVecBinaryMassOf
body:
Prove `PositivityTheory.PfSWUS.HMass.oneVecBinaryMass` directly from `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.SW.UnitVal.density_unit_lattice` in `LocalMassFormula.lean`, eliminating the duplicated local unit-density and Gauss-sum proof chain in `MassTop.lean` and `OneVecBinaryMassOf.lean`.
